summary: Retain positive rejection proof at native launch boundaries

replay.detail: No projection replay or launch replay is introduced.

schema.detail: No additional database or runtime-record layout change.

rules.detail: No replicated claim or checkpoint rule change.

compatibility.detail: Normal exec and PTY starts and PTY rollout starts recheck the selected declaration and retained original requests immediately before each physical launcher. Rejection before the first launcher, or failure to create it, carries exact-operation rejection evidence. Errors or guard rejection after an earlier producer was created retain Unknown; a guarded normal launch cannot adopt an unrelated existing PTY. There is no new PTY option or producer cancellation protocol.

downtime.detail: No interruption beyond the normal deployment restart already classified for the start-operation upgrade.

manual.detail: No additional operator action for a positively rejected native guard.

recovery.detail: Rollback follows the previously classified storage and runtime-state restoration procedure; rejection evidence adds no separate migration.
